'''Statman RalOps - Classic (almost)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Statman]]
* '''Published:''' 13 August 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif|label=Ralltiir Operations}}
* '''Strategy:''' Ralltiir Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 ROps Statman DS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Walkers, Bikes, and Ships!  Classic RalOps!  I need to replace 2 cards to make this classic legal.  I'm looking for suggestions about what works and what doesn't in classic.  Thanks!

The published list has 61 cards.

== Strategy ==

This is one of my standard "Box of Chocolates" decks, becuase it always plays a little differently. A lot of decks will come after this early - as once RalOps gets going, it's a hard road back.

Rendili is in there if your opponent decides to play Battle Plan - otherwise I don't know if I would play it or not.

Speeder Bikes react around, and when you have DLOTS with a saber along with a Speeder Bike reacting him around, you have some good power ready to go.

In space, it's a hodge podge, but I think it's an extremely effective hodge podge, and it's the reason that I haven't moved over to Imperial Domination (V).

I know it needs some work, so feel free to make suggestions. I want to keep the various ground transportation options, but a lot of the rest of the deck is open. Thanks!
